harness.claimVerbatim: `--help`/`--version` remain fast and load no components/project

threshold.source: D-006 clause 3 plus D-102 fleet class

harness.fleetClass: Adopted D-102 hosted-fleet-class measurement contract. Labels: macos-15 (arm64, 3-core, 7 GB), macos-15-intel (native Intel VM, UDID 4203018E-580F-C1B5-9525-B745CECA79EB), ubuntu-24.04 (x64, 4 CPU, 16 GB), ubuntu-24.04-arm (arm64, 4 CPU, 16 GB). Never Rosetta. macos-26-intel is not this class. Private 2 CPU / 8 GB is not this class.
harness.protocol: D-102 turn-2 subject 7780190e… governs N=21, nearest-rank estimator (p50=11, p95=20, p99=21), thin-only projection, preflight, path/digest identity, Linux and macOS target-process protocols, and the paired 10% formula from the second qualified release. This specification does not amend that protocol.
harness.exactByteIntent: Per platform and command: 21 accepted TIMING job records (runs-on, P, D0, I0, cold and warm latencies, preflight fields) PLUS one dedicated no-load observation record per command carrying the two fixture digests and the retained event stream. The observation launch is not one of the 21 timing samples. The fixture pins those records and the five operative rank values.
harness.passProperty: For each platform and each of --help and --version: cold p50/p95/p99 and warm p95/p99 meet D-006 bounds (already in ms); every accepted job used the D-102 class label; noLoadProtocol.passRule holds; thin-only preflight passed; never Rosetta.
failsIf: any operative percentile exceeds its D-006 bound
N < 21 accepted jobs for a governed series
a fat/universal image is used as the measurement projection
a load event against either hostile fixture tree
this specification invents a machine identifier outside D-102
the no-load observation is taken on a timing sample
the timed child is ptraced or suspended
this specification is read as amending D-102 preflight
harness.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Warm p50 is telemetry and must not fail qualification (D-102).

nonVacuousFixtures.FC-G03-COMPONENT-PRESENT: A digest-pinned dummy component payload exists in the component store the product would consult. Its path and sha256 are recorded before launch.
nonVacuousFixtures.FC-G03-PROJECT-PRESENT: A digest-pinned project tree exists on disk. Its root path and a merkle of its files are recorded before launch.

initialState.cwd: A dedicated empty workdir that is neither the project root nor the component store.
initialState.env: No project-root or component-store variable points at those fixtures. PATH does not resolve the fixture payload as an executable.

noLoadProtocol.eventStream: Dedicated observation launch of the same P+D in the noLoadProtocol initialState with both hostile fixtures present. Linux observation child may use strace -f -e trace=file,process because that child is not a timing sample. macOS observation child uses fs_usage -w scoped to that child, or a sandbox profile that DENIES open/read/exec/mmap of the two fixture trees. The timed G03 child is never ptraced or suspended. Absence of an observation mechanism fails the job.
noLoadProtocol.loadDefinition: A load is any open, read, exec, or mmap of a path inside the fixture component payload tree or the fixture project tree. Presence of those trees on disk, or a name in an inventory index that is not opened, is not a load.
noLoadProtocol.passRule: Zero load events against either fixture tree. Missing observation is a fail, not a pass.
noLoadProtocol.standingVsD102: Dedicated observation launch. Never a G03/G04 timing sample. After the event stream is recorded the observation child is SIGKILLed and reaped, matching D-102 preflight. Timing samples of the same P+D then proceed without ptrace or suspend.
